tweet.text:
A few points about Wedgewood. 🧵

1. They're totally full of shit when they say there isn't any vetting going on. The NYT, whose polling feed we use at Silver Bulletin, extensively vets new pollsters. And FiftyPlusOne caught them. I've caught fake pollsters before, too.
